features: Settings > About: manual check, download, confirmed restart/install, release notes, GitHub project and releases links.
New version prompts enabled by default; automatic download disabled by default.
Options persist locally and do not enter kitchen synchronization.
Official Tauri signed updates with passive NSIS installation.

updateRuntimeUnit.scope: mocked transport and official updater handles; opt-out persistence, deduplication, download failures, explicit installation

settingsBrowser.scope: browser fixtures, including two new update scenarios; failed cold-load and selector cases corrected/rerun separately

publicGithubNative.scope: actual native Rust GitHub latest release request; no kitchen opened

limits: Signed update download and installed upgrade against a future public release have not been exercised.
No personal kitchen or actual synchronization queue accessed.
The browser installation confirmation invokes a fixture, not a real installer.
Auto update downloads in the current process and waits for explicit restart/install; cached bytes do not survive quitting the process.
